name: @found-in-space/pas-de-geant-workspace
description: Composable planetary worlds, navigation, and browser experiences

scripts.dev:integration: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @found-in-space/geant-integration --
scripts.build:integration: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @found-in-space/geant-integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace @found-in-space/geant-integration
scripts.build:embed: npm run build --workspace @found-in-space/pas-de-geant && vite build --config vite.embed.config.ts
scripts.build:examples: npm run build --workspace @found-in-space/pas-de-geant && vite build --config vite.examples.config.ts
